project_type: Laravel 12 CMS with Blade templates, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS v4, Vite build
build_system: npm + Vite 8 + @tailwindcss/vite plugin. Build: npm run build. Dev: npm run dev. No separate CSS compile step — Tailwind v4 is processed directly by Vite plugin from resources/css/app.css.
test_framework: Pest (PHPUnit). Run: php artisan test. Quality: composer quality (pint + phpstan + pest)
verification_instructions: 1. php artisan view:clear && php artisan route:clear && php artisan config:clear. 2. npm run build (must complete without errors). 3. php artisan test (no regressions). 4. For frontend visual: load page in browser and inspect rendered output.
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/build/ is generated by npm run build. Do not commit these — they are regenerated.
environment_constraints: Windows OS. Tailwind v4 CSS variables use --color-primary, --color-secondary etc (defined in @theme block in resources/css/app.css). These are different from the theme CSS variables --theme-primary, --theme-secondary output by ThemeService. Alpine.js is loaded via CDN in frontend layout: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.x.x/dist/cdn.min.js. SortableJS must also be loaded from CDN for the admin page builder. Do NOT add npm packages.
contribution_requirements: Match existing code style. Blade components use @php blocks for data extraction. Tailwind classes only — no custom CSS beyond what's already in app.css. CSRF tokens required on all POST forms. Admin views extend admin.layouts.app.
key_patterns: Frontend views extend frontend.layouts.app. Admin views extend admin.layouts.app. ThemeService::applyThemeStyles() returns a CSS string with :root { --theme-primary: X; --theme-secondary: Y; --theme-font-heading: Z; --theme-font-body: W; }. FrontendComposer shares variables with frontend.layouts.app view. PageBuilderController::save() accepts JSON POST body with components[] array (each: component_type, content array, settings array, sort_order int, is_visible bool). Route for save: POST admin/pages/{page}/builder/save named admin.page-builder.save. Alpine.js x-data, x-show, x-model, @click patterns used throughout. CSS color tokens: --color-primary (#3D9E7A), --color-primary-dark, --color-primary-light, --color-secondary (#FE8134), --color-secondary-dark, --color-dark (#0f172a). Tailwind utility classes bg-primary, text-primary, bg-secondary, text-secondary, bg-dark all work via @theme definition in app.css.
directory_structure: app/Services/ (ThemeService.php, MenuService.php etc), app/View/Composers/ (FrontendComposer.php), resources/views/frontend/ (layouts/app.blade.php, page/*, blog/*, home.blade.php), resources/views/admin/ (page-builder/edit.blade.php, themes/), resources/views/components/builder/ (15 component blades), resources/views/themes/ (DOES NOT EXIST yet — create for FEAT-007), database/seeders/ThemeSeeder.php (10 themes with config), database/migrations/2026_10_18_103935_create_themes_table.php
